name: 32708 · Winter Spgs, FL
findings: ZIP 32708 (Winter Spgs) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32708 (Winter Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32708 (Winter Spgs) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
